title: chore(examples): declare @objectstack/organizations in the showcase so a walled os serve boots without a temporary edit
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuDWJsBGQpadCH8JR2xZQ5re)_

Fixes #25365

Clause-②: no

## What changed

- `examples/app-showcase/package.json` declares `@objectstack/organizations` (`workspace:*`, the open Apache-2.0 build, ADR-0132 D3: the host manifest decides which build of the name a deployment gets). The card's option (a).
- `pnpm-lock.yaml`: the one importer link that declaration adds (+3 lines, no other churn).
- `examples/app-showcase/README.md`: a "Booting it walled" section naming the env a production walled `os serve` needs.

The showcase is `private: true`, so nothing publishes: `skip-changeset`.

## Mechanism, measured on `origin/main` 830a63a680

- `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`: `multiTenant = tenancyPosture !== 'single'`; only then is `@objectstack/organizations` imported, through `importFromHost` (resolved from the served app's own `node_modules`). Import failure under a walled posture exits 1 unless `OS_ALLOW_DEGRADED_TENANCY`. Under `single` the import is never reached. All three premises hold.

## Boot readings (head 0cc7b77e12, `NODE_ENV=production`, fresh database each run, `OS_CLOUD_URL=off`)

Common env: `OS_AUTH_SECRET`, `OS_SECRET_KEY`, `OS_DATABASE_URL=file:./.objectstack/data/app.db`; walled runs add `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` and `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only`.

| run | result | decisive line |
|---|---|---|
| `single`, dependency declared | ready, exit 0 on SIGTERM | `Tenancy: single`, `Plugins: 50 loaded`, no `Organizations`; `/auth/config` `multiOrgEnabled:false` |
| `single`, control: package link removed from the showcase's `node_modules` | ready, exit 0 | `Plugins: 50 loaded`; plugin list byte-identical (same md5) to the row above |
| `isolated`, README recipe verbatim (`pnpm exec objectstack serve`) | ready | `Tenancy: isolated`, `Plugins: 51 loaded`, `Organizations` in the list; `/auth/config` `degradedTenancy:false` |
| `group`, README recipe verbatim | ready | `Tenancy: group`, `Plugins: 51 loaded`, `Organizations`; `degradedTenancy:false` |
| `isolated`, control: package link removed | exit 1 | `FATAL: tenancy posture 'isolated' was requested but @objectstack/organizations could not be loaded` |
| `isolated`, no membership policy | exit 1 | `FATAL: tenancy posture 'isolated' is walled, but this deployment never declared a membership policy` (the organizations plugin's own gate: the package loaded) |
| `isolated`, no `OS_SECRET_KEY` | exit 1 | `[LocalCryptoProvider] Refusing to start in production without a stable encryption key` |
| `isolated`, no `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` | exit 1 | `tenancy posture 'isolated' requires OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL to be set` |

The last three rows are why each variable is in the README recipe. Every other example is untouched, so its `single` boot is unchanged by construction.

## Gates (local, head 0cc7b77e12)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 47 commands; 46 exit 0, `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: needs a full build) = NOT MEASURED locally, CI runs it. `--ran` reconciliation: 47 derived, 46 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase run typecheck && … run test`: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 37/37, Tests 443/443.
- `pnpm lint`: VERDICT command-exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- A walled boot of the showcase logs a non-fatal `WARN [security] audience-binding suggestion sync failed` (no organization with slug `default` and more than one organization, so the deployment-level acceptance must come from the security plugin's `acceptedDefaultPermissionSets`). Observation only; the boot is green and this card does not change it.
- The card's third temporary setting (an audience posture with self-registration, for a self-registering tenant) is not needed to boot and is not in the recipe; this PR measured boot only.
